let end_of_text = 3c

    string.compare_ordinal(left, right)

rotations(text: string) -> Pipe[string] =>
    (0..text.length)
        |> map((i: int) => "{text[i..<0]}{text[0..i]}")

last_character(text: string) -> string =>

transform(text: string) -> string =>
    rotations("{start_of_text}{text}{end_of_text}")
        |> sort(ordinal_order)
        |> map(last_character)
        |> join("")

invert(transformed: string) -> string is
    let width = transformed.length
    let table mut = (0..width) |> map((i: int) => "") |> collect()

    for _ in 0..width do
        table = table
            |> index()
            |> map(row => "{transformed[row.index]}{row.value}")
            |> sort(ordinal_order)
            |> collect()
    od

    let framed = table
        |> filter(row => row[row.length - 1] == end_of_text)
        |> only()

    framed[1..width - 1]
si

    text.replace(start_of_text, '^').replace(end_of_text, '|')
